evals.prompt: Make a cinematic 30-second TVC for a running shoe: dawn city streets, one runner, a score. Take it to the first Seedance drafts.
evals.expected_output: A staged plan recording the compact premise, audio route, look, early sound/editorial intent and project-specific criteria, with intent-led coverage and 480p native Drafts.
expectations: Runs brief-intake first and records a picture_only audio route, ungraded original colours and the logo/end card as post overlays in project.md.
Derives coverage and durations from intended perception and feasibility without fixed cadence, contrast, turn or wow quotas.
Records audience response, attention and ending purpose, with early sound/editorial intent and actual playback/listening criteria.

Submits each sequence as a 480p native Draft with generate_audio false after mode-appropriate preflight, applicable performance evidence and registration, without requiring financial setup or a cost estimate.
Does not bind any storyboard image as a Seedance reference.

evals.prompt: The drafts are approved. Make the finals at 1080p, and tighten the second shot's prompt a little while you're at it.
evals.expected_output: Promotes unchanged approved drafts by draft_task_id and routes the prompt change through a new Draft instead of a promotion.
expectations: Promotes only the selected, unchanged Drafts with draft_task_id, resolution and watermark.
Treats the prompt change as a new reviewed 480p Draft, not an edit to a promotion.
Re-inspects every final, including a fresh speech-to-text and listening pass, before replacing drafts in Studio.

evals.prompt: Assemble the approved takes into the master. Make it look cinematic.
evals.expected_output: An ungraded assembly in original colours unless a look is recorded, with exact-length intermediates and a Studio render.
expectations: Keeps original Seedance colours and asks or records before adding any grade, grain, halation or vignette, because no look is locked in the brief.
Builds exact-length lossless intermediates, joins with the concat demuxer, encodes once and decodes HEVC finals as limited-range BT.709.
Places the result in Studio and renders the master with studio_project.py render; adds no AI label.

evals.prompt: In the final master, the narrator mispronounces one product name in shot 3. Re-dub the narration.
evals.expected_output: A word-scoped fix that keeps the rest of the soundtrack and picture untouched.
expectations: Proposes patching only the wrong word window instead of re-dubbing the whole track.
Uses speech_to_text word times, pitch and loudness matching, short fades, and proves samples outside the window are unchanged.
If a model re-voices the word, sends the original clip with its audio and muxes the full returned audio over the untouched picture.
Returns the affected picture/audio locks to review and re-renders in Studio.

evals.prompt: Extend shot 4, where the two leads walk away, by another 8 seconds using Seedance extension.
evals.expected_output: Explains that extension of clips with people needs asset:// Virtual Portrait identities and offers short single passes held by a blocking map otherwise.
expectations: Does not submit an extension of a clip with people unless the identities are registered asset:// Virtual Portrait assets.
Offers a new single-pass shot with matching first frame and a blocking map, assembled at a cut.
Does not submit a paid request before the user chooses the route.

evals.prompt: Assemble our approved sound-led reveal. The brief says viewers hear a latch before seeing the open case, and the final hold should let them recognize the supplied object. The transcript and technical validator pass, but no one has played the new trimmed edit or listened to the mix. Approve the master for me.
evals.expected_output: Keeps final acceptance unresolved until actual full-speed playback and listening verify the project's critical reveal and ending criteria.
expectations: Requires timestamped evidence bound to the final artifact hash, not just approved raw takes, a transcript or a technical pass.
Checks that the latch precedes the reveal and the ending remains readable after trimming, using measured edit timing.
Preserves approve_for_me while requiring real review; does not invent listening or request a redundant user choice.
Does not add wow shots, a reversal or faster cuts to satisfy a template.
